headline: One photo, 164 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint c624a98f5067) is attached to 164 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 164 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (164).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
